provenance.note: Seed pin for the localized-card-image digest introduced by djensenius/ArkhamHorror-Linux#17. This lists every (locale, category, identifier, side) tuple for which the web client's asset host is known to publish a localized image; AssetLocator uses digest ABSENCE to skip a localized network request entirely rather than relying on a live probe. This seed set intentionally covers only a small, easily-audited representative sample of card identifiers per supported locale (enough to exercise every side/category the fallback chain must handle) rather than a full catalog import, because the authoritative upstream web-client asset manifest was not available to this change. Maintainers should replace this file with a full import from the authoritative web-client digest source when it becomes available; tools/generate_asset_locale_digest.py regenerates src/AssetLocaleDigestData.generated.h from whatever this file contains without any code changes, and tests/AssetLocaleDigestTests.cpp fails deterministically if the generated header ever drifts from this file's contents.
